constraints.explanation: The path must start exactly at the specified start position and end exactly at the specified goal position.
All waypoints must lie within the rectangular map boundaries: [0, width] x [0, height].
Every waypoint must maintain a minimum Euclidean distance from each obstacle center, at least the sum of the obstacle radius and the safety distance.
All waypoint coordinates must be finite real numbers.
The number of waypoints in the path must not exceed the maximum specified by max_waypoints.

description: Static 2D UAV path planning problem in a bounded environment with obstacles and a risk zone. The UAV must find a feasible path from start to goal, represented as ordered 2D waypoints, that avoids obstacles by at least the safety distance, stays within map bounds, has a limited number of waypoints, and minimizes a weighted combination of path length, collision cost, smoothness, risk exposure, and waypoint count.
objective: Minimize the weighted sum of five terms: total path length times objective_weights.length, total collision cost times objective_weights.collision, total smoothness penalty times objective_weights.smoothness, total risk exposure (sum over waypoints of the local risk zone weight if inside the zone) times objective_weights.risk, and waypoint count times objective_weights.waypoint. Collision cost is incurred as a large penalty if any waypoint violates obstacle clearance, smoothness penalizes large heading changes between consecutive segments, and risk exposure uses per-zone weights from risk_zones as local multipliers, not the global risk weight.
output: Return a feasible start-to-goal path as ordered 2D waypoints.
